mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a Waxing Gibbous moon visible.

The City of Verona is recruiting an Engineering Technician to oversee infrastructure projects through September 20. Additionally, the city has updated sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure these systems remain self-supporting.
Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or catch the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, look out for yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local safety, an incident occurred on Friday where a driver was arrested for an O W I after officers found her unresponsive behind the wheel near North Main Street.

Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Cashew. If you are looking for other treats today, Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 5 PM and the Verona Area High School Stadium from 1 PM to 7:30 PM. Since Culver's is currently closed, note that they open at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Dark Chocolate PB Crunch flavor.
